page.layout: One printed page, one text block in a single column; a woodcut ornament heading at the top; a large woodcut initial N opening the body; a reference mark "¶.ÿ." set at the foot right below the last line. No margin notes; no running head; no page number printed.

main_text.head: CLARISSIMIS ET Amplissimis viris, Dominis, Prætori, Consulibus, Senatoribus, ac Secretario urbis Leydensis: eiusque Academiæ præfectis, ac Professoribus eruditissimis, Dominis suis plurimum obseruandis,
LAMBERTVS DANÆVS in Christo S. P. D.
main_text.p: ON era nescius, V.Clarissimi, quum ea, quæ ad hucusque diem scitè dicta & certa visa sunt, ad verbi diuini amussim reuocare, fore, vt hic noster labor in varias reprehensiones incurreret. Nam nonnullis, & iis quidem, qui moderatiores videri volunt, hoc totum displicet, mutuis se libris & scriptionibus vexare. Quidam, etsi id totum non reprehendunt, in iis tamen potius versandum fuisse iudicabunt, quæ sunt magis inter nos controversa, & dubia: in iis autem, de quibus antea nemo pene litem mouebat, (qualis est hic primus Sententiarum P. page.notes: The initial N is a decorative woodcut letter, transcribed as "ON" with the N taken as the initial. The opening word "ON" is read as "O N" in the printed text ("O N era"). The final line ends with "&" and the foot mark "¶.ÿ." is a signature-like reference, read with doubt.
